ironActivity.title: OPERATION IRON MERIDIAN
ironActivity.course: Cellebrite Analysis for Defense and Intelligence

sections.title: Workstation Preparation and Case Build
sections.inject: The J2 requires all exploitation to be performed under standardized configuration, documented, and repeatable. Build the workstation, build the ALPHA case, verify the image, and prove the build is repeatable before examining messages.

sections.title: ALPHA Triage: Pattern of Life and Network
sections.inject: ALPHA belongs to the yard leaseholder, assessed as a facilitator. Establish who he contacts, what he calls things, and his activity between 1 February and 1 April 2022. Run the partner agency's MERIDIAN image hash set and check for malware.

sections.title: BRAVO Verification and Validation
sections.inject: BRAVO is the courier's phone. Every finding must be independently validated before it leaves the building: the tool's answer, then the raw database or a second tool saying the same thing. Investigate the native message thread and validate the photographs.

sections.title: CHARLIE: The Foreign-Language Node
sections.inject: Work the password-protected iTunes backup of a handset that remains at large. Establish its device profile, communications, collection opportunities, and locations. Carefully review automated classifications and validate newly parsed artifacts.

sections.title: DELTA: Database Exploitation
sections.inject: The targeting cell needs original filenames, file paths, file sizes, and creation dates—not just pictures. Work in Photos.sqlite, join the required tables in SQLite Wizard, map the results back into Analyzed Data, and validate the output against the raw database. Document missing primary keys and any discrepancy.

sections.title: ECHO and FOXTROT: Legacy Handsets and Hex-Level Recovery
sections.inject: Work the legacy handset memory images: benchmark the hex data, decode 7-bit SMS and PDU timestamps, recover messages and images, and use regular expressions to locate email addresses. Tag recovered evidence and validate the confidence of location findings.

sections.title: GOLF: The Unsupported Device
sections.inject: GOLF is an unsupported binary dump, not an empty device. Review the plug-in chains, apply the correct chain, compare it with the default output, and document the chain composition and recovered intelligence so the next analyst can reproduce your work.

sections.title: Dissemination and the Commander's Brief
sections.inject: Two audiences, two products, one set of findings. The field team needs device attributes and account identifiers. The analytical cell and partner agency need the comprehensive protected product. Then brief the PIRs with evidence and validation methodology.

lanternActivity.scenario: You are a Joint Task Force Mobile Exploitation Cell supporting a coalition partner in a contested information environment. A hostile network is coordinating logistics disruption and influence operations using disposable devices, encrypted chats, and staged media drops. A partner unit executed a lawful, authorized site exploitation and recovered training evidence for rapid triage. Triage the Coordinator iPhone first, then use targeted collection on that same iPhone to refine the courier alias and details. Examine your own assigned SIM and the UFED Classic ZTE training phone, and produce a concise, defensible lead package.
rules: Work only on provided training devices/datasets. Do not connect personal devices.
UFED-only: use UFED outputs and saved reports; no PA or Streamline knowledge is required.
Follow classroom SOPs: document case identifiers, handling notes, and artifact provenance.
Preserved Extraction and SafeGuard are knowledge-based only; classroom phones do not support the preserved workflow and no preserved extraction is supplied.
Triage and targeted collection use the same iPhone. SIMs differ: each IMSI and SIM finding requires individual instructor review.
Capture each flag and obtain instructor approval of written responses to advance. Denied responses require a meaningful revision and another review.
Three hint tokens per team; each hint costs 2 points. Wrong submissions have no penalty.
Accuracy and defensible reasoning matter more than speed. A 10-minute optional break/intel inject follows Mission 3.

Training ZTE phone — UFED Classic tools
Individually assigned training SIM card and SIM/multiSIM adapter
TurboLink for supported iPhone collection; not mandatory for UFED Classic SIM extraction
